spec.description: AWS CodePipeline runs, stages, CodeBuild builds, failures, releases and build log signals, by project.

spec.title: Runs
spec.description: Pipeline runs started in the selected range, vs the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_pipelines AS (
  SELECT x.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(sc.production_pattern, '') = '' THEN 'Not set'
         WHEN (SELECT cp.environment FROM _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e1
               JOIN cicd_pipelines cp ON cp.id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipelineExecution:', e1.connection_id, ':', e1.execution_id)
               WHERE e1.connection_id = x.connection_id AND e1.pipeline_arn = x.arn LIMIT 1) = 'PRODUCTION' THEN 'Production'
         ELSE 'Non-production' END AS env
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.connection_id, p.arn, p.name, p.region, p.url, p.scope_config_id
    FROM project_mapping pm
    JOIN _tool_aws_pipelines p ON pm.row_id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipeline:', p.connection_id, ':', p.arn)
    WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN _tool_aws_scope_configs sc ON sc.id = x.scope_config_id
),
runs AS (
  SELECT e.connection_id, e.execution_id, e.pipeline_arn, sp.name AS pipeline, sp.region, sp.url AS pipeline_url,
    e.status, e.execution_type, e.trigger_type, e.trigger_tag_name, e.start_time, e.last_update_time, sp.env
  FROM scoped_pipelines sp
  JOIN _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e ON e.connection_id = sp.connection_id AND e.pipeline_arn = sp.arn
  WHERE e.start_time >= ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND) AND e.start_time < $__timeTo() AND (${environment:sqlstring} = 'All' OR sp.env = ${environment:sqlstring})
)
SELECT $__timeFrom() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(start_time < $__timeFrom()), 0) AS value FROM runs
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, COALESCE(SUM(start_time >= $__timeFrom()), 0) AS value FROM runs
ORDER BY time

) h

ORDER BY time

spec.title: Runs over time
spec.description: Runs started per day, week or month (by range length), stacked by pipeline: the 8 busiest by name, the rest as Other. Failed runs are in the headline and on the Failures tab. The first and last bars may cover part of a period.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE($__timeFrom()) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT($__timeFrom(), '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY ELSE period_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH END FROM periods WHERE CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY ELSE period_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH END < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_pipelines AS (
  SELECT x.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(sc.production_pattern, '') = '' THEN 'Not set'
         WHEN (SELECT cp.environment FROM _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e1
               JOIN cicd_pipelines cp ON cp.id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipelineExecution:', e1.connection_id, ':', e1.execution_id)
               WHERE e1.connection_id = x.connection_id AND e1.pipeline_arn = x.arn LIMIT 1) = 'PRODUCTION' THEN 'Production'
         ELSE 'Non-production' END AS env
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.connection_id, p.arn, p.name, p.region, p.url, p.scope_config_id
    FROM project_mapping pm
    JOIN _tool_aws_pipelines p ON pm.row_id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipeline:', p.connection_id, ':', p.arn)
    WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN _tool_aws_scope_configs sc ON sc.id = x.scope_config_id
),
runs AS (
  SELECT e.connection_id, e.execution_id, e.pipeline_arn, sp.name AS pipeline, sp.region, sp.url AS pipeline_url,
    e.status, e.execution_type, e.trigger_type, e.trigger_tag_name, e.start_time, e.last_update_time, sp.env
  FROM scoped_pipelines sp
  JOIN _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e ON e.connection_id = sp.connection_id AND e.pipeline_arn = sp.arn
  WHERE e.start_time >= $__timeFrom() AND e.start_time < $__timeTo() AND (${environment:sqlstring} = 'All' OR sp.env = ${environment:sqlstring})
),
labels AS (
  SELECT k, IF(rk <= 8, k, 'Other') AS label FROM (
    SELECT pipeline AS k, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pipeline) AS rk FROM runs GROUP BY pipeline
  ) ranked
),
agg AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE(r.start_time) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(r.start_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.start_time) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT(r.start_time, '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start, l.label, COUNT(*) AS value
  FROM runs r JOIN labels l ON l.k = r.pipeline GROUP BY 1, 2

)
SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_FORMAT(GREATEST(p.period_start, $__timeFrom()), '%m/%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.period_start, '%b %Y') END AS Period, l.label AS metric, COALESCE(v.value, 0) AS value
FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT label FROM labels) l

    IF(t.target REGEXP '^[^ ()]+[:@][^ ()]+( [(].*[)])?$', 'OS', SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.target, ' (', 1)), ')') AS label
  FROM trivy t LEFT JOIN trivy_img i ON i.connection_id = t.connection_id AND i.build_id = t.build_id
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT label, build_id, logged_at, critical, high, medium, low, unknown,

spec.title: Smoke tests and rollbacks
spec.description: Smoke test results and rollback lines found in deployment build logs per bucket. Only builds whose logs were still available are counted.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE($__timeFrom()) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT($__timeFrom(), '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY ELSE period_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH END FROM periods WHERE CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN period_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY ELSE period_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH END < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_pipelines AS (
  SELECT x.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(sc.production_pattern, '') = '' THEN 'Not set'
         WHEN (SELECT cp.environment FROM _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e1
               JOIN cicd_pipelines cp ON cp.id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipelineExecution:', e1.connection_id, ':', e1.execution_id)
               WHERE e1.connection_id = x.connection_id AND e1.pipeline_arn = x.arn LIMIT 1) = 'PRODUCTION' THEN 'Production'
         ELSE 'Non-production' END AS env
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.connection_id, p.arn, p.name, p.region, p.url, p.scope_config_id
    FROM project_mapping pm
    JOIN _tool_aws_pipelines p ON pm.row_id = CONCAT('aws:AwsPipeline:', p.connection_id, ':', p.arn)
    WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN _tool_aws_scope_configs sc ON sc.id = x.scope_config_id
),
runs AS (
  SELECT e.connection_id, e.execution_id, e.pipeline_arn, sp.name AS pipeline, sp.region, sp.url AS pipeline_url,
    e.status, e.execution_type, e.trigger_type, e.trigger_tag_name, e.start_time, e.last_update_time, sp.env
  FROM scoped_pipelines sp
  JOIN _tool_aws_pipeline_executions e ON e.connection_id = sp.connection_id AND e.pipeline_arn = sp.arn
  WHERE e.start_time >= $__timeFrom() AND e.start_time < $__timeTo() AND (${environment:sqlstring} = 'All' OR sp.env = ${environment:sqlstring})
),
actions AS (
  SELECT r.pipeline, r.env, r.execution_id, r.start_time AS run_start, a.connection_id, a.action_execution_id, a.stage_name, a.action_name,
    a.provider, a.status, a.error_code, a.summary, a.start_time, a.last_update_time, a.external_execution_id
  FROM runs r
  JOIN _tool_aws_action_executions a ON a.connection_id = r.connection_id AND a.execution_id = r.execution_id
),
builds AS (
  SELECT a.pipeline, a.env, a.run_start, b.connection_id, b.build_id, b.project_name, b.build_status, b.start_time, b.end_time,
    b.compute_type, b.environment_type, b.image, b.timeout_in_minutes, b.initiator, b.failure_message
  FROM actions a
  JOIN _tool_aws_codebuild_builds b ON b.connection_id = a.connection_id AND b.build_id = a.external_execution_id
  WHERE a.provider = 'CodeBuild'
),
smoke AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE(b.run_start) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(b.run_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(b.run_start) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT(b.run_start, '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start, SUM(LOWER(s.result) = 'passed') AS passed, SUM(LOWER(s.result) = 'failed') AS failed
  FROM builds b JOIN _tool_aws_build_log_signals s ON s.connection_id = b.connection_id AND s.build_id = b.build_id AND s.signal_type = 'SMOKE_TEST'
  GROUP BY 1
),
rb AS (
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31 THEN DATE(b.run_start) WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(b.run_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(b.run_start) DAY) ELSE DATE_FORMAT(b.run_start, '%Y-%m-01') END AS DATE) AS period_start, SUM(m.match_count) AS n_lines
  FROM builds b JOIN _tool_aws_build_log_pattern_matches m ON m.connection_id = b.connection_id AND m.build_id = b.build_id AND m.pattern_name = 'ROLLBACK'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 182 THEN DATE_FORMAT(GREATEST(p.period_start, $__timeFrom()), '%m/%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.period_start, '%b %Y') END AS Period, COALESCE(s.passed, 0) AS "Smoke tests passed", COALESCE(s.failed, 0) AS "Smoke tests failed",
  r.n_lines AS "Rollback lines"
FROM periods p LEFT JOIN smoke s ON s.period_start = p.period_start LEFT JOIN rb r ON r.period_start = p.period_start
ORDER BY p.period_start
